maddeler.e:
ينطفئ (form VII)
# يَنْطَفِئُ (yanṭafiʔu) /jan.tˤa.fi.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# يَنْطَفِئَ (yanṭafiʔa) /jan.tˤa.fi.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
# يَنْطَفِئْ (yanṭafiʔ) /jan.tˤa.fiʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْطَفَأَ (inṭafaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
